headline.zh: 为人形机器人训练收集真实世界数据
headline.en: Collect Real-World Data to Train Humanoid Robots

scenario.zh: 一家物流公司希望训练机器人在仓库内搬运包裹,需要收集人类操作员的动作数据
scenario.en: A logistics company wants to train robots to move packages in warehouses and needs human operator motion data

instruction.zh: 为仓库搬运任务选择合适的数据采集方式
instruction.en: Select the right data collection method for warehouse tasks

output.zh: 配置完成:全身17个关节点追踪,适合精确记录搬运动作
output.en: Configuration ready: 17 joint tracking points, ideal for precise handling motions

output.zh: 配置完成:视觉+IMU传感器,适合快速收集大量场景数据
output.en: Configuration ready: vision plus IMU sensors, ideal for rapidly collecting diverse scenarios

instruction.zh: 定义操作员需要执行的具体任务场景
instruction.en: Define the specific task scenarios operators will perform

output.zh: 任务就绪:固定货架到打包台路线,每班次记录200次重复操作
output.en: Task ready: fixed shelf-to-packing route, 200 repetitions recorded per shift

output.zh: 任务就绪:随机货架位置和障碍物,每班次记录80次不同情况
output.en: Task ready: random shelf positions and obstacles, 80 different situations per shift

instruction.zh: 检查两种采集策略的数据特征
instruction.en: Review data characteristics from both collection strategies

output.zh: 动作序列高度一致,适合学习流畅的基础搬运动作
output.en: Highly consistent motion sequences, suitable for learning smooth basic handling

output.zh: 包含更多应对障碍和调整姿态的片段,适合泛化能力
output.en: Contains more obstacle response and posture adjustment segments, better for generalization

instruction.zh: 汇总采集成果并规划下一步训练
instruction.en: Summarize collection results and plan next training steps

output.zh: 完成:三周采集窗口,标注完成的多模态数据集已同步到训练集群
output.en: Complete: three-week collection window, annotated multimodal dataset synced to training cluster

output.zh: 报告已生成:数据覆盖范围、质量指标和建议的训练配置
output.en: Report generated: data coverage, quality metrics and recommended training configuration

takeaway.zh: 通过真实操作员数据采集,为物理AI提供互联网无法获取的训练素材
takeaway.en: Collect real operator data to provide training material for physical AI that internet cannot supply
